newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl delighted Yeltsin's operation a success.
newsitem.headline: Kohl delighted Yeltsin's operation a success.

text.p: A visibly relieved German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday he was delighted to learn Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation had been a success.
Kohl has become close friends with Yeltsin in recent years and even joined him in a sauna during an official visit in 1993.
"I have good news from Moscow -- everything went well," Kohl told journalists with a broad smile after being asked about difficult German budget negotiations.
Russian surgeons said in Moscow that an operation to repair Yeltsin's damaged arteries had gone well.
